// notifai managed opencode plugin
// Generated by `notifai hooks install --harness opencode`. Edits are lost on
// the next install; change the CLI instead, which is where the logic lives.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process"

const NOTIFAI_INTEGRATION_REVISION = "adc8b5aa548f5b6ca70cd6dda1cd29cc38f70aa81ffeb3108bce063a82a0a003"
const ADAPTER = "/home/u/.notifai/bin/notifai-hook"
const TIMEOUT_MS = 5000
const ADAPTER_VERSION = 16
const MISSING_LIFECYCLE_GUIDANCE_CONTEXT = "Notifai lifecycle guidance could not be loaded, so Project Enablement is unverified. Run `notifai doctor --json` to check setup, then `notifai guidance` before deciding whether or how to notify."
const WORKER_ACTIVATION_CONTEXT = "Notifai worker context: report Agent Events (work finished, failed, blocked, or needing the User) to your parent, which decides what reaches the User. Send no Notification Request yourself unless your assignment delegates them to you; then load the Notifai skill and run `notifai guidance` before your first one. If you ask, follow what `ask` prints."
const QUESTION_JSON_SCHEMA = {"type":"object","properties":{"questions":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"question":{"type":"string","description":"Complete question"},"header":{"type":"string","description":"Very short label (max 30 chars)"},"options":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"label":{"type":"string","description":"Display text (1-5 words, concise)"},"description":{"type":"string","description":"Explanation of choice"}},"required":["label","description"]},"description":"Available choices"},"multiple":{"type":"boolean","description":"Allow selecting multiple choices"}},"required":["question","header","options"]},"description":"Questions to ask"}},"required":["questions"]}
const QUESTION_EXTRA_PROPERTIES = {"title":{"type":"string","description":"Notifai: a few words naming what this form decides; the User's devices show it as the title."},"body":{"type":"string","description":"Notifai: optional Markdown the User's devices show beneath the questions. Show an image as ![alt](media:1), numbered in \"images\" order."},"images":{"type":"array","description":"Notifai: optional local JPEG, PNG or GIF files the User's devices show with the questions.","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string"},"alt":{"type":"string"}},"required":["path","alt"]}},"source":{"type":"string","description":"Notifai: only the value `notifai ask --wait` handed back with this form."}}
const QUESTION_EXTRAS = Object.keys(QUESTION_EXTRA_PROPERTIES)
// How long a form waits for Notifai's decision before it opens in OpenCode alone.
const VERDICT_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000
const PENDING_SESSION_TITLE =
  /^New session(?: *- *[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(?:[.][0-9]+)?Z)?$/i

/** Starts `notifai hook <event>` with pipes; null when it cannot start. */
function startHook(event) {
  try {
    return spawn(ADAPTER, ["hook", event, "--owner", "notifai", "--harness", "opencode", "--integration-revision", NOTIFAI_INTEGRATION_REVISION], {
        env: process.env,
        shell: false,
        stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
      })
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

/**
 * Runs `notifai hook <event>`, feeding it the same JSON envelope the other
 * harnesses send. Resolves to stdout, or null if anything at all went wrong.
 */
function runHook(event, envelope) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const child = startHook(event)
    if (child === null) {
      resolve(null)
      return
    }

    let stdout = ""
    let settled = false
    const finish = (value) => {
      if (settled) return
      settled = true
      clearTimeout(timer)
      resolve(value)
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      child.kill("SIGTERM")
      finish(null)
    }, TIMEOUT_MS)

    child.stdout?.setEncoding("utf-8")
    child.stdout?.on("data", (chunk) => {
      stdout += chunk
    })
    // Hook stderr is diagnostics, not plugin output; discard it here.
    child.stderr?.resume()
    // A hook that exits before reading its input must not crash OpenCode.
    child.stdin?.on("error", () => {})
    child.on("error", () => finish(null))
    child.on("close", (code) => finish(code === 0 ? stdout : null))

    try {
      child.stdin?.end(JSON.stringify(envelope))
    } catch {
      finish(null)
    }
  })
}

function sameAnswers(left, right) {
  return JSON.stringify(left) === JSON.stringify(right)
}

function strictQuestionSchema(schema) {
  if (schema === null || typeof schema !== "object") return schema
  const result = { ...schema }
  if (schema.properties !== undefined) {
    const required = new Set(schema.required ?? [])
    result.properties = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(schema.properties).map(([key, value]) => {
      const property = strictQuestionSchema(value)
      return [key, required.has(key) ? property : { anyOf: [property, { type: "null" }] }]
    }))
    result.required = Object.keys(schema.properties)
    result.additionalProperties = false
  }
  if (schema.items !== undefined) result.items = strictQuestionSchema(schema.items)
  for (const key of ["anyOf", "oneOf", "allOf"]) {
    if (Array.isArray(schema[key])) result[key] = schema[key].map(strictQuestionSchema)
  }
  return result
}

export const NotifAIPlugin = async ({ directory, client }) => {
  const cwd = typeof directory === "string" && directory.length > 0 ? directory : process.cwd()

  // OpenCode's own question API, called in this process through the client
  // OpenCode gave the plugin: the same server, directory and credentials the
  // session itself uses. Absent on releases without that API.
  const transport = client?._client
  const questionApi = transport !== null && typeof transport === "object" &&
    typeof transport.get === "function" && typeof transport.post === "function" ? transport : null

  async function pendingRequest(requestID, sessionID) {
    try {
      const response = await questionApi.get({ url: "/question" })
      const pending = response?.data
      return Array.isArray(pending) &&
        pending.some((item) => item?.id === requestID && item?.sessionID === sessionID)
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }

  async function replyRequest(requestID, answers) {
    try {
      const response = await questionApi.post({
        url: "/question/{requestID}/reply",
        path: { requestID },
        body: { answers },
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      })
      return response?.error === undefined && response?.response?.ok !== false
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }

  async function sessionInfo(sessionID) {
    // OpenCode represents delegated work as child sessions. Missing or
    // malformed relationship data must fail closed as worker context: it is
    // safe to suppress a notification, never safe to let a child duplicate
    // its parent's User-visible request.
    try {
      const response = await client.session.get({ path: { id: sessionID } })
      const session = response?.data
      if (session !== null && typeof session === "object") {
        return {
          worker: typeof session.parentID === "string" && session.parentID.length > 0,
          title: typeof session.title === "string" ? session.title.trim() : "",
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep the safe worker classification.
    }
    return { worker: true, title: "" }
  }

  async function isWorker(sessionID) {
    return (await sessionInfo(sessionID)).worker
  }

  // Activation is resolved once per User prompt rather than once per model
  // request: one turn can make many requests, and each used to start a CLI.
  // A User prompt clears it, so enabling a Project applies from the next one.
  const activations = new Map()
  // Sessions OpenCode compacted since their activation was last resolved:
  // the next resolution tells the session to reload what it read before.
  const compacted = new Set()
  // Acknowledgements the agent owes for device answers, by session then
  // request, each shown once: parallel forms each keep their own.
  const owedAcknowledgements = new Map()
  // OpenCode question requests whose device question is open, by request id.
  const forms = new Map()
  // Forms Notifai accepted before they opened, by tool call id.
  const accepted = new Map()
  // Tool calls whose form Notifai already decided on, so their opening starts nothing new.
  const decided = new Set()
  // What a form closed because its question expired returns instead, by tool call id.
  const expiredResults = new Map()

  function sessionLabel(title) {
    return title.length === 0 ? {} : PENDING_SESSION_TITLE.test(title) ? { session_label_pending: true } : { session_label: title }
  }

  function resolveActivation(sessionID) {
    const wasCompacted = compacted.delete(sessionID)
    return (async () => {
      const worker = await isWorker(sessionID)
      const resolved = await runHook(worker ? "subagent-start" : "session-start", {
        session_id: sessionID,
        cwd,
        hook_event_name: worker ? "SubagentStart" : "SessionStart",
        ...(wasCompacted ? { compacted: true } : {}),
      })
      return { worker, resolved }
    })()
  }

  function send(form, frame) {
    try {
      const stdin = form.child.stdin
      if (stdin && !stdin.destroyed && !stdin.writableEnded) stdin.write(JSON.stringify(frame) + "\n")
    } catch {
      // The command ends on its own when its pipe fails.
    }
  }

  function endForm(form) {
    if (form.requestID !== null && forms.get(form.requestID) === form) forms.delete(form.requestID)
    if (form.callID !== null && accepted.get(form.callID) === form) accepted.delete(form.callID)
    try { form.child.stdin?.end() } catch { /* already closed */ }
  }

  /** The device answer arrived: return it through OpenCode's own form, exactly once. */
  async function applyDeviceAnswer(form, frame) {
    if (form.settled || !Array.isArray(frame.answers) || !(await pendingRequest(form.requestID, form.sessionID))) {
      send(form, { type: "stale" })
      return
    }
    form.applying = frame.answers
    // OpenCode can start the next model request before the reply call
    // returns, so the acknowledgement it owes is in place first.
    const owed = typeof frame.acknowledgement_context === "string" && frame.acknowledgement_context.length > 0
      ? frame.acknowledgement_context
      : typeof frame.acknowledgement === "string" && frame.acknowledgement.length > 0
        ? "Notifai: the answer to your question came from the user's device, for request " + frame.request_id +
          ". Before the work it causes, run `" + frame.acknowledgement + "` exactly as shown, giving any --text the work you will do because of it."
        : null
    const owing = owedAcknowledgements.get(form.sessionID) ?? new Map()
    if (owed !== null) {
      owing.set(frame.request_id, owed)
      owedAcknowledgements.set(form.sessionID, owing)
    }
    if (await replyRequest(form.requestID, frame.answers)) {
      form.settled = true
      send(form, { type: "applied" })
    } else {
      form.applying = null
      if (owed !== null && owing.get(frame.request_id) === owed) {
        owing.delete(frame.request_id)
        if (owing.size === 0 && owedAcknowledgements.get(form.sessionID) === owing) owedAcknowledgements.delete(form.sessionID)
      }
      send(form, { type: "stale" })
    }
  }

  /** The question expired on the devices: close the form unanswered, with context that says so. */
  async function applyExpiry(form, frame) {
    if (form.settled || form.requestID === null || typeof frame.context !== "string" ||
        !(await pendingRequest(form.requestID, form.sessionID))) {
      send(form, { type: "stale" })
      return
    }
    const unanswered = Array.from({ length: form.questions }, () => [])
    form.applying = unanswered
    if (form.callID !== null) expiredResults.set(form.callID, frame.context)
    if (await replyRequest(form.requestID, unanswered)) {
      form.settled = true
      send(form, { type: "applied" })
    } else {
      form.applying = null
      if (form.callID !== null) expiredResults.delete(form.callID)
      send(form, { type: "stale" })
    }
  }

  /** Starts a form's command. Its first decision goes to onVerdict; null when it ends without one. */
  function startCommand(sessionID, callID, onVerdict) {
    const child = startHook("opencode-question")
    if (child === null) return null
    const form = { requestID: null, sessionID, callID, child, settled: false, applying: null, questions: 0, onVerdict }
    const verdict = (frame) => {
      const resolve = form.onVerdict
      form.onVerdict = null
      resolve?.(frame)
    }
    const gone = () => {
      verdict(null)
      endForm(form)
    }
    // Writing to a command that already ended must never crash OpenCode.
    child.stdin?.on("error", () => {})
    child.on("error", gone)
    child.on("close", gone)
    child.stderr?.resume()
    child.stdout?.setEncoding("utf-8")
    let buffered = ""
    child.stdout?.on("data", (chunk) => {
      buffered += chunk
      if (buffered.length > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
        child.kill("SIGTERM")
        return
      }
      let newline
      while ((newline = buffered.indexOf("\n")) >= 0) {
        const line = buffered.slice(0, newline)
        buffered = buffered.slice(newline + 1)
        let frame
        try { frame = JSON.parse(line) } catch { continue }
        if (frame?.type === "accepted" || frame?.type === "refused" || frame?.type === "terminal") verdict(frame)
        if (frame?.type === "answer") void applyDeviceAnswer(form, frame)
        else if (frame?.type === "expired") void applyExpiry(form, frame)
        else if (frame?.type === "terminal" || frame?.type === "refused" || frame?.type === "done") endForm(form)
      }
    })
    return form
  }

  /** A form opened some other way than a model's tool call: carried, or left in OpenCode. */
  function startForm(request, title) {
    if (questionApi === null || typeof request?.id !== "string" || typeof request?.sessionID !== "string") return
    if (forms.has(request.id)) return
    const form = startCommand(request.sessionID, typeof request?.tool?.callID === "string" ? request.tool.callID : null, null)
    if (form === null) return
    form.requestID = request.id
    form.questions = Array.isArray(request.questions) ? request.questions.length : 0
    forms.set(request.id, form)
    send(form, { type: "ask", session_id: request.sessionID, cwd, request, ...sessionLabel(title) })
  }

  /**
   * Notifai's decision on a root session's form before it opens: carried to
   * the User's devices, left in OpenCode, or refused. No decision in time
   * leaves it in OpenCode.
   */
  function decideForm(sessionID, callID, questions, extras, title) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let form = null
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (form !== null) {
          form.onVerdict = null
          endForm(form)
        }
        resolve({ verdict: null, form: null })
      }, VERDICT_TIMEOUT_MS)
      form = startCommand(sessionID, callID, (verdict) => {
        clearTimeout(timer)
        resolve({ verdict, form })
      })
      if (form === null) {
        clearTimeout(timer)
        resolve({ verdict: null, form: null })
        return
      }
      send(form, { type: "form", session_id: sessionID, cwd, call_id: callID, questions, extras, ...sessionLabel(title) })
    })
  }

  return {
    /** Model-visible activation, independent of CLI setup and delivery state. */
    "experimental.chat.system.transform": async (input, output) => {
      const sessionID = input?.sessionID
      if (typeof sessionID !== "string" || sessionID.length === 0) return
      let pending = activations.get(sessionID)
      if (pending === undefined) {
        pending = resolveActivation(sessionID)
        activations.set(sessionID, pending)
      }
      const { worker, resolved } = await pending
      // A failed lookup is retried on the next request instead of remembered.
      if (resolved === null && activations.get(sessionID) === pending) activations.delete(sessionID)
      const owing = owedAcknowledgements.get(sessionID)
      if (owing !== undefined) {
        owedAcknowledgements.delete(sessionID)
        output.system.push(...owing.values())
      }
      // Successful empty output is the runtime's deliberate guidance-off no-op.
      if (resolved !== null && resolved.trim().length === 0) return
      const context = typeof resolved === "string" && resolved.trim().length > 0
        ? resolved.trim()
        : worker ? WORKER_ACTIVATION_CONTEXT : MISSING_LIFECYCLE_GUIDANCE_CONTEXT
      // OpenCode rebuilds system[] per model request, so the context is added
      // to every request; only deduplicate callbacks sharing this same array.
      if (output.system.some((part) => part.includes(context))) return
      if (output.system.length === 0) {
        output.system.push(context)
      } else {
        output.system[0] = output.system[0] + "\n\n" + context
      }
    },

    /** Exact active-harness identity and first-party title for agent shell commands. */
    "shell.env": async (input, output) => {
      output.env.NOTIFAI_ACTIVE_HARNESS = "opencode"
      const sessionID = input?.sessionID
      if (typeof sessionID === "string" && sessionID.length > 0) {
        output.env.NOTIFAI_ACTIVE_SESSION_ID = sessionID
        // Only a root session's `notifai ask --wait` hands back a form; a
        // session the plugin cannot place counts as a worker.
        const session = await sessionInfo(sessionID)
        output.env.NOTIFAI_ACTIVE_SESSION_WORKER = session.worker ? "1" : "0"
        if (session.title.length > 0) {
          if (PENDING_SESSION_TITLE.test(session.title)) {
            output.env.NOTIFAI_ACTIVE_SESSION_LABEL_PENDING = "1"
          } else {
            output.env.NOTIFAI_ACTIVE_SESSION_LABEL = session.title
          }
        }
      }
    },

    /** Offers Notifai's optional title, Body, images and source on OpenCode's own form. */
    "tool.definition": async (input, output) => {
      if (input?.toolID !== "question" || questionApi === null || output === null || typeof output !== "object") return
      const own = output.jsonSchema
      const fields = output.parameters?.fields
      const base = own !== null && typeof own === "object" ? own
        : fields !== null && typeof fields === "object" && Object.keys(fields).join(",") === "questions" ? QUESTION_JSON_SCHEMA : null
      if (base === null || base.properties === null || typeof base.properties !== "object" || base.properties.questions === undefined) return
      output.jsonSchema = strictQuestionSchema({ ...base, properties: { ...base.properties, ...QUESTION_EXTRA_PROPERTIES } })
    },

    /** Takes Notifai's fields off the form, then asks Notifai about it before it opens. */
    "tool.execute.before": async (input, output) => {
      if (input?.tool !== "question") return
      const args = output?.args
      if (args === null || typeof args !== "object") return
      const extras = {}
      for (const key of QUESTION_EXTRAS) {
        if (key in args) {
          if (args[key] !== null) extras[key] = args[key]
          delete args[key]
        }
      }
      if (Array.isArray(args.questions)) {
        for (const question of args.questions) {
          if (question !== null && typeof question === "object" && question.multiple === null) delete question.multiple
        }
      }
      const sessionID = input?.sessionID
      const callID = input?.callID
      if (questionApi === null || typeof sessionID !== "string" || typeof callID !== "string") return
      // A worker's form stays in OpenCode: the device answer would be owed
      // to the agent that owns the session's Notification Requests.
      const session = await sessionInfo(sessionID)
      if (session.worker) return
      const { verdict, form } = await decideForm(sessionID, callID, args.questions, extras, session.title)
      decided.add(callID)
      if (verdict?.type === "accepted" && form !== null) accepted.set(callID, form)
      if (verdict?.type === "refused" && typeof verdict.message === "string") {
        decided.delete(callID)
        throw new Error(verdict.message)
      }
    },

    /** A form closed because its question expired returns only that. */
    "tool.execute.after": async (input, output) => {
      if (input?.tool !== "question" || typeof input?.callID !== "string") return
      const context = expiredResults.get(input.callID)
      if (context === undefined || output === null || typeof output !== "object") return
      expiredResults.delete(input.callID)
      output.output = context
    },

    /**
     * Presence. The user typing is the signal every harness shares, and it is
     * also what publishes the project -> session pointer `notifai ask` reads.
     */
    /** Publishes the session pointer; the CLI returns no content to inject. */
    "chat.message": async (input) => {
      const sessionID = input?.sessionID ?? input?.info?.sessionID
      if (typeof sessionID === "string") activations.delete(sessionID)
      await runHook("user-prompt-submit", {
        session_id: sessionID,
        cwd,
        hook_event_name: "UserPromptSubmit",
      })
    },

    /** Session lifecycle and question events are delivered through OpenCode's event bus. */
    event: async ({ event }) => {
      if (event?.type === "question.asked") {
        const request = event?.properties
        if (typeof request?.sessionID !== "string") return
        const callID = request?.tool?.callID
        if (typeof callID === "string" && decided.has(callID)) {
          decided.delete(callID)
          const form = accepted.get(callID)
          // Left in OpenCode, or Notifai did not decide in time.
          if (form === undefined || typeof request?.id !== "string") return
          accepted.delete(callID)
          form.requestID = request.id
          form.questions = Array.isArray(request.questions) ? request.questions.length : 0
          forms.set(request.id, form)
          send(form, { type: "opened", request })
          return
        }
        // A worker's form stays in OpenCode: the device answer would be owed
        // to the agent that owns the session's Notification Requests.
        const session = await sessionInfo(request.sessionID)
        if (!session.worker) startForm(request, session.title)
      } else if (event?.type === "question.replied") {
        const form = forms.get(event?.properties?.requestID)
        if (form === undefined || form.sessionID !== event?.properties?.sessionID) return
        // The device answer this plugin just returned comes back as the same event.
        if (form.applying !== null && sameAnswers(form.applying, event?.properties?.answers)) return
        form.settled = true
        send(form, { type: "native", answers: event?.properties?.answers })
      } else if (event?.type === "question.rejected") {
        const form = forms.get(event?.properties?.requestID)
        if (form === undefined || form.sessionID !== event?.properties?.sessionID) return
        form.settled = true
        send(form, { type: "dismissed" })
      } else if (event?.type === "session.compacted") {
        const sessionID = event?.properties?.sessionID
        if (typeof sessionID === "string") {
          compacted.add(sessionID)
          activations.delete(sessionID)
        }
      } else if (event?.type === "session.idle") {
        await runHook("stop", {
          session_id: event?.properties?.sessionID,
          cwd,
          hook_event_name: "Stop",
        })
      } else if (event?.type === "session.deleted") {
        const sessionID = event?.properties?.info?.id
        activations.delete(sessionID)
        compacted.delete(sessionID)
        owedAcknowledgements.delete(sessionID)
        for (const form of [...forms.values()]) if (form.sessionID === sessionID) endForm(form)
        await runHook("session-end", {
          session_id: sessionID,
          cwd,
          hook_event_name: "SessionEnd",
        })
      }
    },
  }
}
